summary: The host overlay rail: icon destinations with Profile first and Search second, a white focus pill, and a scrim that closes onto the exact tile the viewer left. Games and Live TV appear only when those add-ons are installed.

items.description: Destination rows in host order: Profile, Search, Home, Movies, Series, then Games and Live TV when their add-ons are installed, then Settings.

showsLive.description: Include the Live TV row only when the household's hub carries the live add-on and a playlist.

showsGames.description: Include the Games row only when an enabled add-on declares the games resource.

profileFirst.description: Search sits after Profile, above Home, as the owner requested.

focusFill.description: The host owns the white pill; a pack brand fill disappeared on Kids and Glass.
